items.title: Democrats win big after Trump alienates voters
items.feedTitle: Democrats win big after Trump alienates voters
items.summary: Donald Trump's rhetoric and policy failures contributed to significant losses for Republicans in congressional elections, even as Democrats secured victories across several key states. The midterm results represent a rejection of Trump's leadership and approach by American voters.

items.title: Texas's new Democratic governor vows to undo policies
items.feedTitle: Texas’s new Democratic governor Hinojosa vows to undo policies she calls divisive
items.summary: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has pledged to reverse policies she characterizes as divisive in her incoming administration. Her election marks a major Democratic breakthrough in a traditionally conservative state.

items.title: California governor commutes all death sentences
items.feedTitle: Newsom plans to commute all of California's death sentences
items.summary: Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the sentences of California's entire death row population—548 people—to life without parole. The decision represents a significant reversal of decades of capital punishment policy in the state.

items.title: Harmeet Dhillon resigns from Justice Department Civil Rights
items.feedTitle: Harmeet Dhillon resigns after radical reshape of Justice Department's Civil Rights Division
items.summary: Harmeet Dhillon, the Assistant Attorney General who oversaw the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division, has resigned after 18 tumultuous months marked by dramatic changes to the division's direction. Her departure signals a shift in how the federal government will approach civil rights enforcement.

items.title: Judge blocks Trump's arch construction for 14 days
items.feedTitle: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
items.summary: A federal judge has halted construction on Trump's proposed triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., moments after a federal planning panel approved it. The blockade delays work that the administration hoped to begin immediately.

stlouis.title: St. Louis Cardinals promote Cerfolio to General Manager
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Cardinals promote from within, tap Cerfolio as GM
stlouis.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals organization promoted Rob Cerfolio to the position of General Manager, marking an internal promotion within the franchise. The decision reflects the team's confidence in Cerfolio's leadership capabilities.

stlouis.title: St. Louis allocates funds for tornado repairs
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Mayor Cara Spencer unveils plan to replace trees lost in May 2025 tornado
stlouis.summary: Mayor Cara Spencer unveiled a plan to replace trees lost in May 2025 tornado damage that affected the city. The city has allocated resources to address the storm's impact on urban infrastructure and greenery.

stlouis.title: Missouri and Saint Louis renew basketball rivalry
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri men's basketball to face Saint Louis for first time in 25 seasons
stlouis.summary: The University of Missouri and Saint Louis University are renewing their college basketball rivalry for the first time in 25 seasons. The matchup marks a significant return of one of the region's traditional competitive relationships.

items.title: Meghan Markle's father arrested on CSAM charges
items.feedTitle: Thomas Markle, Meghan’s father, arrested in Florida on charges related to child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Thomas Markle Sr., the estranged father of Meghan Markle, was arrested by federal agents in Florida on charges related to child sexual abuse material. The arrest came after federal law enforcement investigation into his possession of such material.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader sentenced to 200 years for murders
items.feedTitle: Kenyan cult leader sentenced to 200 years in prison for mass starvation murders of children
items.summary: Paul Mackenzie, leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect, has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 190 children and one adult. Followers had been ordered to starve themselves and their families in the forest.

items.title: South African ANC faces bruising electoral defeat
items.feedTitle: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted
items.summary: The African National Congress, South Africa's once-dominant liberation party under Nelson Mandela, is on course to suffer its worst election result, with support falling below one-third of the national vote in local elections. The decline reflects widespread public dissatisfaction with the party's governance.

items.title: European flights hit by fresh wave of bomb threats
items.feedTitle: Further bomb threats disrupt at least another 18 flights across Europe
items.summary: A second wave of bomb threats disrupted air traffic across Europe on Friday, affecting at least 18 flights, though searches revealed no explosive devices and all aircraft landed safely. The coordinated threat campaign mirrors earlier disruptions this week.

items.title: Paraguay's president resigns after bank collapse
items.feedTitle: Paraguay’s president quits after millions of people’s savings frozen in bank crisis
items.summary: Santiago Peña, Paraguay's rightwing president, resigned after a political and financial crisis that froze millions of people's savings when Ueno Bank collapsed. The crisis prompted impeachment proceedings and widespread public outcry over the banking system failure.

items.title: Stricter pollution curbs imposed in Delhi-NCR ahead Diwali
items.feedTitle: Stricter Pollution Curbs Under GRAP-III Imposed In Delhi-NCR Ahead Of Diwali
items.summary: Delhi-NCR authorities have imposed GRAP-III (Graded Response Action Plan) restrictions as air quality worsens ahead of Diwali celebrations. Multiple areas in the region have entered the 'severe' pollution zone, prompting stricter vehicle and industrial controls.

items.title: India records 12.6% less rainfall, fourth-lowest in 125 years
items.feedTitle: El Niño Effect: India Records 12.6% Less Rainfall, Fourth-Lowest In 125 Years
items.summary: India has recorded 12.6% less rainfall this year, marking the fourth-lowest annual rainfall in 125 years of data, attributed to El Niño effects. The shortfall has implications for agriculture, water resources, and food security across the nation.

items.title: Karnataka petrol contains ethanol up to 31% above limit
items.feedTitle: Lab tests show ethanol blend in petrol as high as 31% in Karnataka
items.summary: Lab tests in Karnataka have revealed petrol samples containing ethanol blends as high as 31%, exceeding the government's 20% limit. The state government has raised concerns about fuel quality and potential vehicle damage from excessive ethanol content.

items.title: CBI books Kishore Biyani in Rs 904 crore bank fraud case
items.feedTitle: CBI Files Rs 904-Crore Bank Fraud Case Against Businessman Kishore Biyani
items.summary: The CBI has filed charges against Future Retail founder Kishore Biyani and others in connection with an alleged Rs 904 crore bank fraud involving SBI. The agency alleges the company failed to utilize loan facilities in accordance with terms and conditions.

items.title: Nifty reclaims 25,000, Sensex crosses 81,000 mark
items.feedTitle: Nifty reclaims 25,000, Sensex crosses 81,000 as India shrugs off global tech rout
items.summary: Indian stock markets have surged with Nifty reclaiming the 25,000 level and Sensex crossing 81,000, defying the global tech selloff that followed the U.S. midterms. The strong performance reflects resilience in Indian equities amid foreign fund inflows.

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic extensions for employment authorization documents
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: Finalized and in effect. An interim final rule published October 30, 2025 amended DHS regulations to end the practice of automatically extending the validity of Forms I-766 (EADs) for aliens who have timely filed for renewal. This change affects workers awaiting adjudication of renewal applications.

immigration.title: USCIS proposes removing deference to prior visa determinations
immigration.feedTitle: Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility
immigration.summary: Proposed, not final. DHS has proposed removing 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5), which currently provides that USCIS gives deference to prior approvals involving the same facts when adjudicating extension petitions for alien employment. This change would increase scrutiny on repeated visa applications.

items.title: Global tech stocks recover after worst day in 19 months
items.feedTitle: US tech stocks recovering on Wall Street after worst day in 19 months – as it happened
items.summary: After suffering their worst day in 19 months, U.S. tech stocks staged a recovery on Friday as dip-buyers offered support. European and Asia-Pacific markets had slid earlier in the session following Wall Street's Thursday rout, which was partially driven by AI regulation fears following the U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: U.S. economy adds 165,000 jobs in October surprise
items.feedTitle: US job growth exceeds expectations in October despite economic uncertainty
items.summary: The U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, significantly exceeding economist expectations, while the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%. The strong jobs report suggests labor market resilience despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns.

items.title: Oil prices slide below $100 amid Iran war uncertainty
items.feedTitle: Oil Slides Below $100 a Barrel, With Focus on Iran Outlook After U.S. Midterms
items.summary: Oil prices have slid below $100 a barrel as investors reassess the outlook for the U.S.-Iran conflict following Democratic midterm victories. Traders are pricing in potential de-escalation, which has pressured crude values despite tanker attacks in the Persian Gulf.

items.title: Fox closes $22 billion acquisition of Roku streaming
items.feedTitle: Fox Closes $22 Billion Roku Takeover, Says Streaming Platform Will Remain ‘Open Ecosystem’
items.summary: Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, creating a new streaming power player. The deal consolidates Fox's position in streaming media as the company focuses on its direct-to-consumer platform strategy.

items.title: Indian market adds Rs 29.57 lakh crore in best week
items.feedTitle: Rs 29.57 lakh crore added to investor wealth! Why Sensex, Nifty had best week in over 5 years
items.summary: Indian stock markets have added Rs 29.57 lakh crore to investor wealth in their best week in over five years, with Sensex and Nifty posting their strongest gains since February 2021. The rally was fueled by Diwali optimism and foreign fund inflows defying global tech selloffs.

cards.title: Small Commitments Compound
cards.insight: People often abandon goals by trying to change everything at once. Research on behavior shows that consistent, incremental shifts—even tiny ones—build momentum and neurological pathways that make larger transformations possible over time. Repetition shapes identity more than willpower.
cards.takeaway: Pick one specific habit change this week and commit to it for just 21 days; track it visibly to reinforce the behavior loop.

cards.title: Environment Is Stronger Than Intention
cards.insight: Willpower depletes; friction does not. People who succeed at behavior change typically reshape their environment—removing triggers for old habits and adding friction to bad choices—rather than relying on self-discipline alone. Context beats motivation.
cards.takeaway: Identify the top barrier to your desired habit and engineer one environmental change to reduce that friction this week.

cards.title: Identity Precedes Action
cards.insight: Saying 'I want to exercise' is fragile; saying 'I am someone who moves daily' is durable. When people internalize a behavioral identity, actions follow naturally because they become self-consistent. The shift from outcome-focused to identity-focused thinking is a powerful lever.
cards.takeaway: Reframe your goal as a character trait: instead of 'I will save money,' adopt 'I am intentional with resources.' Notice how the shift changes motivation.

cards.title: Accountability Multiplies Adherence
cards.insight: Public commitments and social accountability dramatically increase follow-through rates—not because shame works, but because humans are wired for reciprocity and reputation. Telling one trusted person about a goal roughly doubles success rates compared to private goals.
cards.takeaway: Share your habit change goal with one person and agree to a weekly check-in; the social contract will anchor you more than willpower ever could.

ai.summary: OpenAI's CFO Sarah Friar told CNBC that the company will continue its planned $1.4 trillion investment in AI data centers despite the post-midterm selloff and regulatory backlash. The commitment signals OpenAI's determination to proceed with massive infrastructure expansion.

ai.feedTitle: Anthropic IPO Valuation Could Be Slashed in Half to $1T After AI Stock Rout: Report
ai.summary: Anthropic's planned IPO valuation is facing a sharp downward revision, potentially falling from $1.5 trillion to $1 trillion or lower following the tech stock rout. The dramatic cut reflects investor reassessment of AI company valuations amid regulatory uncertainty.

ai.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for cybersecurity threats
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber After AI Helps Find 81 Firefox Flaws, 948 Linux Exploits
ai.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber, a new AI model specialized for finding software vulnerabilities. The model has already identified thousands of exploits, including 81 Firefox flaws and 948 Linux exploits, demonstrating its capability in digital defense.

ai.title: OpenAI president signals potential 2027 IPO readiness
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
ai.summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman stated at a Wall Street Journal conference that the company could be ready for an IPO in 2027. Brockman highlighted the company's growing success in the enterprise market segment.
